Joint pain, stiffness and weakness can make everyday activities challenging. When pain leads you to move less, the muscles supporting your joints may become weaker, making movement more difficult. The right kind of regular exercise, appropriate yoga practices and healthy daily habits can help improve mobility and manage symptoms.
In this video, Hansaji shares a practical 21-day routine to support joint health, build strength and encourage safe, consistent movement.
What you will learn:
1. How gentle Sahaj Bhavasana movements can help ease the body into the day.
